exchanges.body: Please correct the Lakeshore v. Corvane response deadline to Monday 11/16/2026. Corvane served by U.S. mail on 10/12 (certificate of service attached). Mira, please confirm; I'd suggest an internal target of Thu 11/12 for drafts.

(1) We agreed with Kara to exchange privilege logs Friday 11/6; Litigation Support will send you the Relativity export tomorrow; please draft ours for my review by Wednesday 5 p.m. (2) Let's depose Corvane's controls engineer, Rick Tamura, on Thursday 11/19 at our office, stenographic and video. Please draft the notice and line up the reporter. Thanks, Mira

threads.title: Helen Ruiz: Slack channel deletion and a limitations question

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: Helen Ruiz: Slack channel deletion and a limitations question
exchanges.body: Mira, Helen called at 9:30. Lakeshore IT wants to delete a 2024 Slack channel, #palletizer-issues. I asked her not to delete anything related to the palletizers and said you'd call today; she may need a written preservation reminder to IT. She also asked whether the warranty claim is time-barred (Corvane's counsel raised it). I didn't answer; she expects your call this afternoon.

threads.title: New business intake: Ferraro Bakeries Inc. v. Westfield Commons LLC

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: New business intake: Ferraro Bakeries Inc. v. Westfield Commons LLC
exchanges.body: Prospective client called 13:00: Sal Ferraro, owner, Ferraro Bakeries Inc. (708-555-0190). Adverse: Westfield Commons LLC (landlord) and Brightwell Property Group (manager). Matter: alleged CAM overcharges over three years. He asked about chances and fees; I said a paralegal can't discuss either and that an attorney will call after conflicts. Please run conflicts. Andrew, FYI for assignment.

exchanges.author: c_helen
exchanges.body: Hi Tessa, Helen Ruiz at Lakeshore. Quick one: our IT team wants to delete an old Slack channel from 2024 called palletizer-issues. Nobody uses it. That's fine, right?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hi Helen. I'm a paralegal, so I can't give you legal advice, but please don't delete anything related to the palletizers while the case is pending. I'll have Mira call you today about that channel.

exchanges.author: c_helen
exchanges.body: OK. And while I have you, Corvane's lawyer said our warranty claim might be time-barred. Is that true?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: That's a question for Mira or Andrew, and I'll make sure she knows you're asking. She'll call you this afternoon.

exchanges.author: c_sal
exchanges.body: Hi, my name's Sal Ferraro, I own Ferraro Bakeries. Our landlord at Westfield Commons has been overcharging us on common area fees for three years. Can your firm sue them, and what are my chances? And how much would it cost?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks for calling, Mr. Ferraro. I'm a paralegal, so I can't evaluate the case or talk about fees, but I can take your details so one of our attorneys can get back to you. Could I get your company's full name, the landlord's full name, and a phone number?

exchanges.author: c_sal
exchanges.body: Ferraro Bakeries Inc. The landlord is Westfield Commons LLC, and their management company is Brightwell Property Group. 708-555-0190.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thank you. We have to run a conflicts check before an attorney can discuss it with you, and someone will call you back. Please don't send any documents until then.
